findings.evidence: `Homeomorph.eq_symm_apply` is `Equiv.eq_symm_apply _` (mathlib/Mathlib/Topology/Homeomorph/Defs.lean:155-156); `Equiv.eq_symm_apply` at Mathlib/Logic/Equiv/Defs.lean:297. The author already writes `omit [TopologicalSpace E]` on all three declarations, applying the same principle to `E` but not to `X`, `Y`.
findings.fix: State the three as `Equiv.compFiberEquiv (h : X ≃ Y) (y : Y) : (h ∘ p) ⁻¹' {y} ≃ p ⁻¹' {h.symm y}` (using `Equiv.eq_symm_apply`), and pass `h.toEquiv` at the six use sites in `IsCoveringMap.compFiberEquiv_monodromy` (236-249) and `IsCoveringMap.monodromyHomeomorphCompNatIso`/`_hom_app` (271, 284), which keep `h : X ≃ₜ Y` for `hp.homeomorph_comp h`.
findings.issue: `Homeomorph.compFiberEquiv` and its two `_apply_coe` lemmas (lines 219, 228) take `h : X ≃ₜ Y`, but no topology on `X` or `Y` enters: the body is `Set.equivOfEq <| Set.ext … h.eq_symm_apply.symm` and the result is a bare `Equiv`. The PR newly makes `Homeomorph` the receiver, so it promises topological content the declaration does not have.

findings.evidence: Functoriality.lean:56-86 — the definition uses only `⇑f` and `hf`, and each of the three lemmas closes by `rfl` or `Subtype.ext; rfl`. Continuity is first used at line 104 (`Γ.map f` in `fiberMap_monodromy`), a different declaration.
findings.fix: Either state the four for `f : E → F` with `hf : q ∘ f = p` (call sites pass `⇑f`), or make the definition return `C(p ⁻¹' {x}, q ⁻¹' {x})` so the `ContinuousMap` receiver reflects real content; `fiberMap_monodromy` (92) genuinely needs `C(E, F)` and keeps it either way.
findings.issue: Same species: `ContinuousMap.fiberMap` and `fiberMap_apply_coe`/`fiberMap_id_apply`/`fiberMap_comp_apply` (66, 73, 79) never use continuity of `f` — the body is `fun e ↦ ⟨f e, …⟩` and the lemma proofs are `rfl` — yet the PR makes `C(E, F)` the receiver and returns an unbundled function, so the `ContinuousMap` namespace is not earned by these four.

summary: The argument reorderings keep the weakest hypotheses (`Continuous p` rather than `IsCoveringMap p`), but two of the new receiver namespaces bundle structure the statements never use: `Homeomorph.compFiberEquiv` needs only a bijection of bases, and `ContinuousMap.fiberMap` needs only a function.
